title: 污染土壤洗滌~Soil washing for remediation
focus: 追蹤污染物在粗土、細泥與洗液間的分配以評估土壤洗滌~Evaluate soil washing by following contamination among coarse soil, fines and wash water
summary: 本課以「追蹤污染物在粗土、細泥與洗液間的分配以評估土壤洗滌」為主軸，依序處理場址分區與代表樣本、乾基污染庫存、洗液負荷與水循環、含水與產品重量、泵送與洗滌能耗。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Evaluate soil washing by following contamination among coarse soil, fines and wash water, progressing through Site zones and representative samples, Dry-basis contaminant inventory, Wash-water load and recycle, Moisture and product mass, Pumping and washing energy. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 場址分區與代表樣本~Site zones and representative samples
units.mechanism: 先用歷史活動和粒徑區分土壤群，避免把不相容污染混成平均樣。 網格數需向上取整；空間覆蓋與熱點偵測機率是不同的採樣設計問題。~Group soils by history and size before sampling, avoiding composites that hide incompatible contaminants. Grid counts round upward; spatial coverage and hotspot detection probability are different sampling-design questions.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽樣區域 A=10000 m²；每格面積 a=400 m²。公式 N=ceil(A/a)，計算得 25 sample cells。適用邊界：規則平面網格計數，未指定法規採樣密度或統計信賴。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Survey area A=10000 m²; grid-cell area a=400 m². Formula N=ceil(A/a) gives 25 sample cells. Applicability: Regular planar-grid counting, not a regulatory density or statistical confidence claim.
units.verify: 針對「場址分區與代表樣本」，將網格覆在地形與歷史活動圖上，保留障礙區與針對性樣本的理由。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Site zones and representative samples, Overlay the grid on terrain and historical activities; document inaccessible cells and targeted samples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 規則網格漏掉小型污染熱點，需與歷史與現場證據合併。 在「場址分區與代表樣本」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A regular grid may miss small hotspots and must be combined with history and field evidence. Mark where this error can enter the Site zones and representative samples flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 樣本平均值低就代表每個未採樣位置也都低。~A low sample mean proves every unsampled location is also low.
units.practice: 只將 a 改成 300 m²，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 25 變成 34 sample cells。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only cell area a to 300 m², holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 25 to 34 sample cells. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 污染細粒與粒徑分級~Contaminated fines and size classification
units.mechanism: 細粒高比表面常富集吸附污染物，洗滌可將它們集中而非化學消滅。 粒徑分級先改變後續處理對象；篩孔名目尺寸不等於每顆粒都能通過的保證。~High-surface-area fines often concentrate sorbed contaminants; washing can concentrate rather than destroy them. Size classification changes the downstream feed; nominal aperture is not a guarantee that every smaller particle passes.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：進料 m=1000 kg；細粒比例 f=0.30；細粒捕集率 r=0.90。公式 mf=m*f*r，計算得 270 kg。適用邊界：只算細粒回收，不含粗粒誤入及顆粒團聚。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Feed m=1000 kg; fines fraction f=0.30; fines capture r=0.90. Formula mf=m*f*r gives 270 kg. Applicability: Fines recovery only; coarse misplacement and agglomeration are omitted.
units.verify: 針對「污染細粒與粒徑分級」，分別量進料與兩出口的粒徑分布，檢查堵孔、含水與旁通。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Contaminated fines and size classification, Measure feed and both outlet size distributions, checking blinded apertures, moisture and bypass. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 濕料結團讓可回收細粒留在粗料中。 在「污染細粒與粒徑分級」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Wet agglomeration retains recoverable fines in the coarse stream. Mark where this error can enter the Contaminated fines and size classification flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 篩孔大小可以完全決定所有顆粒的分離結果。~Aperture size completely determines the separation of every particle.
units.practice: 只將 r 改成 0.70，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 270 變成 210 kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only capture r to 0.70, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 270 to 210 kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 乾基污染庫存~Dry-basis contaminant inventory
units.mechanism: 進料污染總量需結合乾重和分析濃度，含水變化不能冒充去污。 先把濕土換成乾重，再乘相同乾基分析濃度；mg 污染物最後換算成 kg，避免含水率假造移除量。~Initial contaminant inventory requires dry mass and concentration; moisture changes cannot stand in for cleanup. Convert wet soil to dry mass before multiplying by matching dry-basis concentration, then convert pollutant mg to kg to avoid moisture-driven apparent removal.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：土壤濕重 mw=1000 kg；濕基水分 w=0.30；乾基濃度 Cd=200 mg/kg dry。公式 mp=mw*(1-w)*Cd/1e6，計算得 0.14 kg contaminant。適用邊界：含水率和濃度代表同批土壤，未含洗液或其他出口，分析濃度不是總土壤成分百分比。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet soil mw=1000 kg; wet-basis moisture w=0.30; dry-basis concentration Cd=200 mg/kg dry. Formula mp=mw*(1-w)*Cd/1e6 gives 0.14 kg contaminant. Applicability: Moisture and concentration represent the same soil batch; wash water and other outlets are excluded, and analytical concentration is not bulk component percentage.
units.verify: 針對「乾基污染庫存」，同步取含水與化學分析樣，核對乾基標記及 mg/kg 單位，再與全部固液出口比對。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Dry-basis contaminant inventory, Collect moisture and chemical samples together, verify dry-basis labels and mg/kg units and reconcile all solid and liquid outlets. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 將乾基濃度乘濕重會高估污染庫存，且使不同含水批次不可比。 在「乾基污染庫存」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Multiplying dry-basis concentration by wet mass overstates inventory and prevents fair comparison across moisture states. Mark where this error can enter the Dry-basis contaminant inventory flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 土壤乾基 mg/kg 可以直接乘未扣水的濕土重量。~Dry-basis soil mg/kg can be multiplied directly by wet soil mass without removing water.
units.practice: 只將乾基濃度 Cd 改成 150 mg/kg dry，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.14 變成 0.105 kg contaminant。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only dry-basis concentration Cd to 150 mg/kg dry, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.14 to 0.105 kg contaminant. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 粗細料污染收支~Coarse-fine contaminant balance
units.mechanism: 將洗後粗料與細泥同時化驗，檢查污染物是否被集中到需要後續處理的物流。 洗滌把污染物集中到細粒或水相，清潔粗料改善須以所有出口的質量收支支持。~Assay washed coarse soil and fines together to confirm transfer into a stream needing further treatment. Washing transfers contaminants into fines or water; improved coarse material must be supported by a balance across all outlets.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：土壤 m=1000 kg；原濃度 C0=200 mg/kg；細粒產物 mf=200 kg、Cf=800 mg/kg。公式 remaining=(m*C0-mf*Cf)/(m-mf)，計算得 50 mg/kg。適用邊界：雙固體出口、無水相流失的簡化；真實洗滌需另量洗液和污泥。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Soil m=1000 kg; initial C0=200 mg/kg; fine product mf=200 kg with Cf=800 mg/kg. Formula remaining=(m*C0-mf*Cf)/(m-mf) gives 50 mg/kg. Applicability: A two-solid-output example with no aqueous loss; real washing must also quantify wash water and sludge.
units.verify: 針對「粗細料污染收支」，同步量粗細料乾重和濃度，加入洗液負荷後檢查閉合率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Coarse-fine contaminant balance, Measure dry masses and concentrations of both solids and include wash-water load in closure checks. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只檢驗粗料而忽略細泥，會遺失污染轉移的去向。 在「粗細料污染收支」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Testing only coarse solids loses the contaminant transferred to fines. Mark where this error can enter the Coarse-fine contaminant balance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 粗料濃度降低證明污染物已在洗滌中完全分解。~Lower coarse-soil concentration proves complete contaminant destruction during washing.
units.practice: 只將 Cf 改成 700 mg/kg，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 50 變成 75 mg/kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only fine-product Cf to 700 mg/kg, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 50 to 75 mg/kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 洗液負荷與水循環~Wash-water load and recycle
units.mechanism: 循環水可累積溶解污染物，回用不代表污染負荷從系統消失。 流量與濃度共同決定質量負荷；mg/L 乘 m³/d 後除以 1000 得 kg/d。~Recycled water can accumulate dissolved contaminants; reuse does not remove their load from the system. Flow and concentration jointly determine mass loading; divide mg/L times m³/d by 1000 to obtain kg/d.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：流量 Q=120 m³/d；濃度 C=250 mg/L。公式 load=Q*C/1000，計算得 30 kg/d。適用邊界：流量與樣品代表同一時間窗；單點濃度不能代替流量加權平均。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Flow Q=120 m³/d; concentration C=250 mg/L. Formula load=Q*C/1000 gives 30 kg/d. Applicability: Flow and concentration represent the same time window; a grab value does not replace a flow-weighted mean.
units.verify: 針對「洗液負荷與水循環」，對齊流量計與採樣時間，以分時段 Q×C 加總，核對總量與單位。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Wash-water load and recycle, Align flow-meter and sampling timestamps; sum interval Q×C and check totals and units. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只比較濃度會把稀釋當成污染質量已移除。 在「洗液負荷與水循環」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A concentration-only comparison can mistake dilution for pollutant removal. Mark where this error can enter the Wash-water load and recycle flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 出流水濃度下降就代表污染總量一定下降。~A lower effluent concentration always means a lower total pollutant load.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 150 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30 變成 37.5 kg/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 150 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 30 to 37.5 kg/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 固液停留與分離~Solids-liquid residence and separation
units.mechanism: 攪拌和分離的停留時間不同，需防止細泥隨粗料帶出。 名目停留時間由有效體積除以通過流量；短流、死區及固液停留差異不在單一平均值內。~Mixing and separation have different residence needs; prevent fines from leaving with coarse product. Nominal residence time is effective volume divided by flow; short circuits, dead zones and separate solids retention are not represented by one mean.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：有效體積 V=600 m³；平均流量 Q=30 m³/d。公式 HRT=V/Q，計算得 20 d。適用邊界：穩態平均流量及單相有效體積近似，不預測停留時間分布。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Effective volume V=600 m³; mean flow Q=30 m³/d. Formula HRT=V/Q gives 20 d. Applicability: Steady mean flow and a single effective volume; no residence-time distribution is predicted.
units.verify: 針對「固液停留與分離」，先扣除無效空間，再用示蹤或批次記錄核對停留時間是否分散。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Solids-liquid residence and separation, Subtract inactive volume, then compare tracer or batch records to detect a broad residence-time distribution. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把幾何容積當有效容積，會掩蓋短流與未處理區。 在「固液停留與分離」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Using geometric volume as effective volume hides short-circuiting and untreated zones. Mark where this error can enter the Solids-liquid residence and separation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 有相同平均停留時間的設備，其所有粒子停留時間都相同。~Equal mean residence times imply identical residence times for every particle.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 40 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 20 變成 15 d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 40 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 20 to 15 d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 含水與產品重量~Moisture and product mass
units.mechanism: 洗後土壤很濕，評估減量或回收時必須回到一致乾基。 水和乾固體分別守恆；濕基含水率以總濕重作分母，乾固體重量才能跨不同含水狀態比較。~Washed soil is wet; compare reduction or recovery on a common dry basis. Track water and dry solids separately; wet-basis moisture uses total wet mass as denominator and dry mass permits comparison across moisture states.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕樣總重 mw=1000 kg；濕基含水率 w=0.30。公式 md=mw*(1-w)，計算得 700 kg dry solids。適用邊界：批次代表性樣本，乾燥減重視為水；揮發性物質或結晶水可能使此假設失效。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet sample mass mw=1000 kg; wet-basis moisture w=0.30. Formula md=mw*(1-w) gives 700 kg dry solids. Applicability: A representative batch sample with drying loss treated as water; volatile matter or bound water may invalidate the assumption.
units.verify: 針對「含水與產品重量」，保存稱重、乾燥方法及分樣紀錄，對比重複樣並檢查非水揮發損失。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Moisture and product mass, Retain weighing, drying method and subsampling records and compare duplicates while checking non-water volatile loss. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 用濕重比較處理前後會把脫水誤認為固體去除。 在「含水與產品重量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Comparing wet masses can mistake dewatering for solids removal. Mark where this error can enter the Moisture and product mass flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 濕樣減重多少就代表固體或污染物被去除多少。~Wet-mass reduction equals the mass of solids or contaminants removed.
units.practice: 只將濕基含水率 w 改成 0.40，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 700 變成 600 kg dry solids。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only wet-basis moisture w to 0.40, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 700 to 600 kg dry solids. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 處理後浸出驗證~Post-treatment leaching verification
units.mechanism: 總濃度降低與環境可移動性不同，適用性判斷需匹配使用情境和試驗。 浸出質量可由液體濃度和體積換算，但不能把此值當成樣品總含量。~Lower total concentration differs from mobility; match intended reuse with suitable tests. Released mass follows liquid concentration and volume, but is not the specimen total content.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：浸出液濃度 C=2 mg/L；液體體積 V=2 L；試樣乾質量 m=0.10 kg。公式 released=C*V/m，計算得 40 mg/kg dry sample。適用邊界：以單次均勻浸出作教學換算；不同方法的液固比、pH 和時間不可混用。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Leachate concentration C=2 mg/L; liquid volume V=2 L; dry specimen m=0.10 kg. Formula released=C*V/m gives 40 mg/kg dry sample. Applicability: A single homogeneous extraction for teaching conversion; do not mix liquid/solid ratios, pH or duration across methods.
units.verify: 針對「處理後浸出驗證」，記錄方法、空白、液固比和乾重，將浸出 mg/L 與換算 mg/kg 分欄呈現。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Post-treatment leaching verification, Record method, blanks, liquid/solid ratio and dry mass; display leachate mg/L separately from converted mg/kg. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 浸出液 mg/L 誤標成固體 mg/kg 會改變結論。 在「處理後浸出驗證」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Labelling leachate mg/L as solid mg/kg changes the interpretation. Mark where this error can enter the Post-treatment leaching verification flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 一次浸出試驗能直接得到樣品的所有污染物總含量。~One leaching test directly gives all total contaminant content.
units.practice: 只將 C 改成 3 mg/L，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 40 變成 60 mg/kg dry sample。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only C to 3 mg/L, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 40 to 60 mg/kg dry sample. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 泵送與洗滌能耗~Pumping and washing energy
units.mechanism: 額外用水與泵送可能抵銷部分處理優勢，應列出相同功能單位。 泵功率需包含靜揚程、摩擦和局部損失的總揚程；效率隨運轉點變動。~Additional water and pumping can offset some benefits; use the same functional unit for comparison. Pump duty uses total head including static lift, friction and local losses; efficiency varies with operating point.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：水量 Q=0.01 m³/s；總揚程 H=15 m；ρ=1000 kg/m³；g=9.81 m/s²；η=0.65。公式 P=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1000，計算得 2.26385 kW。適用邊界：清水密度與固定效率概念估算，不替代含固體泵選型或防爆設計。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Water flow Q=0.01 m³/s; total head H=15 m; ρ=1000 kg/m³; g=9.81 m/s²; η=0.65. Formula P=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1000 gives 2.26385 kW. Applicability: A water-density, fixed-efficiency estimate, not solids-pump selection or hazardous-area design.
units.verify: 針對「泵送與洗滌能耗」，同時讀取液位、流量、壓力和電力，核對實際工作點。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Pumping and washing energy, Read levels, flow, pressure and power together to verify the actual operating point. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 管道堵塞會提高阻力，固定額定功率不代表固定流量。 在「泵送與洗滌能耗」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Pipe blockage raises resistance; a fixed motor rating does not imply fixed flow. Mark where this error can enter the Pumping and washing energy flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 馬達額定功率相同的泵在任何管線都提供相同流量。~Pumps with the same motor rating deliver the same flow through any pipe system.
units.practice: 只將 H 改成 20 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.26385 變成 3.01846 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only H to 20 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2.26385 to 3.01846 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 質量閉合與未知去向~Mass closure and unresolved pathways
units.mechanism: 如果各出口污染總量無法閉合，先檢查含水、取樣與洗液，再討論反應。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。~If outlet inventories do not close, check moisture, sampling and wash water before claiming reaction. Relative variances of independent product quantities approximately add; common calibration sources require covariance.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Independent relative standard uncertainties: flow uQ=0.04, concentration uC=0.06. Formula u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty. Applicability: Small-error first-order propagation and independence; standard uncertainty is not a 95% interval.
units.verify: 針對「質量閉合與未知去向」，建立每項不確定度來源表，將重複性、校正和代表性分開，檢查相關性。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Mass closure and unresolved pathways, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「質量閉合與未知去向」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Mass closure and unresolved pathways flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 重複量測次數越多，所有系統性誤差都會自動消失。~More repeats automatically eliminate every systematic error.
units.practice: 只將 uC 改成 0.03，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072111 變成 0.05 relative standard uncertainty。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only uC to 0.03, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.072111 to 0.05 relative standard uncertainty. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
